nodes.label: Index Branch (block-level Top-k selector)
nodes.rationale: Trained with KL-alignment against the (detached) Main Branch's own attention distribution plus gradient detachment and a full-attention warmup period, each layer countering a distinct identified failure mode (no gradient signal; backbone gaming the auxiliary loss; fragile selection during early attention-entropy shifts).

nodes.label: Exp-free Top-k selection kernel
nodes.rationale: Skips softmax's max/exp/sum normalization before rank-based selection since softmax is strictly order-preserving and cannot change which indices are top-k, giving an exact (non-approximate) speedup.
